title: ControlPlaneAdrFrontmatter
description: SPEC §6.2: an ADR's YAML frontmatter. Ids follow plane.json `ids.adr` (default ADR-NNNN). Undeclared keys are read and warned about by `ccp docs check`, refused under `adr.strict`.

status.description: One of plane.json adr.statuses; moved by `ccp adr status` along adr.transitions

supersedes.description: ADRs or decisions this ADR replaces

superseded_by.description: The ADR(s) that replace this one as a whole; status superseded needs it

amends.description: ADRs or decisions this ADR changes without replacing

review_points.description: Review points it is built in (the register's ids)

spec_refs.description: SPEC sections it relies on or changes

decisions.description: Each decision's build state, one entry per decision in the body

notes.description: Free text: dated status notes (`ccp adr status --note`), anything the fields do not hold

link.description: <ADR id>, or <ADR id> D<n> for one decision

decision.description: D<n> <state>[ by <ADR id>[ D<n>]][ — <note>]; state not_built | built | live | retired
